newsitem.title: INDIA: India TELCO 96/97 sales up 24 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: India TELCO 96/97 sales up 24 pct - paper.

text.p: Vehicle sales of leading Indian truckmaker Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd (TELCO) rose 24 percent during 1996/97 (April-March), the Economic Times newspaper said on Wednesday.
The newspaper said in an unsourced report that sales had risen to 203,800 units in the year-ended March 31, 1997, from 164,100 a year earlier.
TELCO sold 42,000 units of the Sumo model during the year, up from 22,000 in 1995/96.
"Recording a 90 percent growth during the year, the Sumo with sales of 42,000 is responsible for a major proportion of the company's success," the newspaper said.
